page.content:
Mars 2020 rover caching samples in Jezero Crater and carrying Ingenuity.

How Perseverance connects

  • Faction: Mars Exploration Program — Perseverance is the Mars 2020 rover of the Mars Exploration Program.
  • Vehicle: Curiosity — Perseverance followed Curiosity as NASA's next nuclear-powered Mars rover.

What is Perseverance?

Perseverance landed in Jezero in 2021 to collect core samples for a future return and deployed the Ingenuity helicopter, extending rover lore into flight on Mars.

Key threads lead to Mars Exploration Program and Curiosity.
